tooltip.reikogodzilla.heav: Reverse-gravity drives: the only safe way through a Hollow Earth vortex. R: sonar scan, V: flares.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.apex_mechagodzilla: Linked through a Ghidorah skull. R: Proton Scream, V: rocket fist, G: thrusters. Full power needs a Hollow Earth Energy Core... and risks waking Ghidorah's mind.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.kong_axe: Forged from a dorsal plate of Godzilla's kind. Use on Kong to arm him: it drinks in atomic breath.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.beast_glove: Bio-Enhanced Anatomech Seismic Thunder. Use on Kong: heals frostbite, shields against cold, electrifies his punches.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.ghidorah_skull: Torn from King Ghidorah. Its dead neurons still answer a telepathic link.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.hollow_earth_core: Energy from deep in the Hollow Earth. Enough to bring a machine to full power.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.dorsal_plate: A dorsal plate from Godzilla's kind. Holds atomic energy.
message.reikogodzilla.alpha_call: King Ghidorah's Alpha Call echoes across the world...
message.reikogodzilla.alpha_call_answere: King Ghidorah's Alpha Call echoes across the world. %s Titans answer it!
message.reikogodzilla.alpha_fallen: The false king is dead. The Titans are free of his call.
message.reikogodzilla.titans_bow: The false king is dead. The Titans bow to Godzilla.
message.reikogodzilla.ghidorah_head_seve: One of King Ghidorah's heads is torn away!
message.reikogodzilla.ghidorah_head_regr: King Ghidorah's head has grown back.
message.reikogodzilla.mv_godzilla_energi: Godzilla glows with absorbed radiation: he is supercharged!
message.reikogodzilla.mv_godzilla_overlo: Too much radiation! Godzilla is going thermonuclear!
message.reikogodzilla.mv_godzilla_mothra: Mothra's life-force falls upon Godzilla... he goes thermonuclear!
message.reikogodzilla.mv_godzilla_evolve: Godzilla has absorbed the stored solar radiation. He emerges Evolved!
message.reikogodzilla.kong_axe: Kong takes up the Battle Axe.
message.reikogodzilla.kong_glove: The B.E.A.S.T. Glove locks onto Kong's arm.
message.reikogodzilla.kong_axe_charged: Kong's axe is full of atomic energy!
message.reikogodzilla.kong_frostbite: Kong's arm is frozen! He needs heat... or the B.E.A.S.T. Glove.
message.reikogodzilla.kong_grown: Kong has grown into the King of Skull Island!
message.reikogodzilla.crystal_shattered: The Skar King's crystal shatters! Shimo is free.
message.reikogodzilla.shimo_free: Shimo is free of the crystal, and she remembers who chained her.
message.reikogodzilla.skar_king_falls: The Skar King has fallen. The Great Apes are free.
message.reikogodzilla.ice_age: The sky turns white. An ice age is beginning...
message.reikogodzilla.muto_nest: The MUTO has laid a nest of eggs! Destroy them before they hatch.
message.reikogodzilla.mothra_peace: Mothra comes between Godzilla and Kong. The fight is over.
message.reikogodzilla.tiamat_falls: Tiamat is dead. The solar radiation in her lair glows unclaimed...
message.reikogodzilla.apex_powered: Mechagodzilla is at full power. You feel something else stir in the link...
message.reikogodzilla.apex_rogue: Ghidorah's mind seizes Mechagodzilla! It has gone rogue!
message.reikogodzilla.storm_wall: The storm wall is tearing the aircraft apart!
message.reikogodzilla.vortex_inversion: Gravity flips! Without reverse-gravity drives the crossing hurts.
message.reikogodzilla.vortex_heav_in: Reverse-gravity drives engaged. Welcome to the Hollow Earth.
message.reikogodzilla.vortex_heav_out: Reverse-gravity drives engaged. Back on the surface.
event.reikogodzilla.monsterverse_godzill: Monarch reports: Godzilla is on the move, heading for the coast...
event.reikogodzilla.muto: The ground splits open. A MUTO emerges... and far away, something answers its call.
event.reikogodzilla.scylla: Something with too many legs is climbing out of the earth...
event.reikogodzilla.behemoth: The trees shake. Behemoth is passing through.
event.reikogodzilla.alpha_call: A storm rolls in from nowhere. Monster Zero has come.

tooltip.reikogodzilla.kiryu.controls: R twin masers · V missiles/railguns · G Absolute Zero Cannon (40% power) · Recharge with a White Heron Power Cell

tooltip.reikogodzilla.gotengo.controls: R maser cannons · V Freezing Maser · G drill ram · Sneak+use to pack up

tooltip.reikogodzilla.supersonic_oscilla: Supersonic waves along your view. Stuns Titanosaurus; staggers other kaiju.

tooltip.reikogodzilla.organizer_g1: Godzilla's regenerative cells. Eating one heals you fast.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.white_heron_cell: Use on Kiryu to restore half its power.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.kiryu_kai_kit: Use on Kiryu: the Triple Hyper Maser replaces the Absolute Zero Cannon, and the right hand becomes the Spiral Claw.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.godzilla_bones: Part of the skeleton of the 1954 Godzilla. Kiryu is built around it.
message.reikogodzilla.mg2_shutdown: Katsura's link is broken. Mechagodzilla 2 shuts down.
message.reikogodzilla.jet_jaguar_grow: Jet Jaguar grows to fighting size!
message.reikogodzilla.jet_jaguar_shrink: Jet Jaguar shrinks back to normal size.
message.reikogodzilla.jet_jaguar_self_aw: Jet Jaguar has broken free of Seatopia and become self-aware. No one can control it now.
message.reikogodzilla.jet_jaguar_none: None of your Jet Jaguars are in range (or they're still recovering).
message.reikogodzilla.minilla_grew: Minilla has grown up a little.
message.reikogodzilla.minilla_hatched: Minilla has hatched! Something is coming to see what made that noise...
message.reikogodzilla.king_caesar_awaken: The song is sung. King Caesar awakens!
message.reikogodzilla.titanosaurus_free: Titanosaurus's control implant is destroyed. He is free.
message.reikogodzilla.oscillator_hit: The supersonic waves shriek through Titanosaurus's implant!
message.reikogodzilla.gmk_wound: A wound has opened in Godzilla's shoulder. Fire a D-03 into it!
message.reikogodzilla.orga_cannon: Orga's shoulder cannon is destroyed. Its regeneration falters.
message.reikogodzilla.orga_emerges: The Millennian crawls from the wreck... it has taken Godzilla's DNA. Orga is born!

message.reikogodzilla.kiryu_rampage: Godzilla's roar has woken the spirit inside Kiryu. It's rampaging!
message.reikogodzilla.kiryu_kai: Kiryu has been rebuilt as Kiryu Kai.
message.reikogodzilla.keizer: Monster X sheds its exoskeleton... Keizer Ghidorah!
message.reikogodzilla.transmitter_destro: The %s control signal has been cut!
message.reikogodzilla.tide_no_sky: The satellite can't reach a target that isn't under open sky or is in water.
message.reikogodzilla.tide_jammed: The lock-on is being jammed by Meganula!
event.reikogodzilla.gigan: A blue crystal streaks out of the sky. The Space Hunter Nebula M have sent Gigan... and King Ghidorah.
event.reikogodzilla.megalon: The ground splits open. Seatopia has sent its god: Megalon!
event.reikogodzilla.hedorah: A choking smog rolls in. Something is flying inside it...
event.reikogodzilla.xilien_invasion: Saucers over the horizon. The Xiliens have come, and they've brought monsters.
event.reikogodzilla.monster_x: A Xilien fleet lands. Their trump card steps out: Monster X!
event.reikogodzilla.titanosaurus: Something huge rises from the sea, and Mechagodzilla walks beside it.
event.reikogodzilla.orga: The sea boils. A UFO rises from the depths.
event.reikogodzilla.meganulon: Something is crawling out of the water...
event.reikogodzilla.gmk_godzilla: Godzilla comes ashore, eyes white and empty. The Guardians stir.
event.reikogodzilla.kamacuras: A buzzing like a swarm of engines: Kamacuras!

tooltip.reikogodzilla.drone_swarm: Launches six drones that circle the nearest kaiju: bait for Shin Godzilla's dorsal beams.

tooltip.reikogodzilla.balloon_rig: After the Freon sinks Godzilla, release the balloons to haul him back up.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.radiation_buoy: Points to the nearest kaiju within 256 blocks.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.gravity_gland: Ghidorah's anti-gravity organ: use it to float up and drift down.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.emp_probe: Fire into Godzilla Earth's dorsal fins while his shield is down. Three in a row overload him.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.orthogonal_diagona: Uses an Archetype crystal to crystallize Red Dust nearby and disrupt Singular Point Godzilla.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.coagulant_canister: Blood coagulant: ammunition for the coagulant pump.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.shin_tissue: Tissue from a creature that evolves in hours.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.contaminated_blood: Blood shed by Shin Godzilla: the base for its coagulant.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.regenerating_tissu: Still twitching. It heals whoever eats it, violently.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.metallic_fiber: Metal-laced plant fiber from Godzilla Earth's planet.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.archetype_crystal: Crystallized Red Dust. Upgrades Jet Jaguar and feeds the Diagonalizer.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.diagonalizer_code: The finished Orthogonal Diagonalizer code. Only Jet Jaguar PP can release it.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.houtua_scale: A Houtua healing scale: carried in a Vulture, it keeps nanometal assimilation out.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.garbetrium_shard: A shard of the Exif's Garbetrium.

tooltip.reikogodzilla.shinden.controls: R cannons · V arm/disarm the charge · G eject
tooltip.reikogodzilla.vulture: A nanometal powered suit. Flown near a living nanometal core, it slowly assimilates its pilot.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.vulture.controls: R rail cannons · V EMP harpoon
tooltip.reikogodzilla.jet_jaguar_pp: The Otaki Factory robot. Feed it Archetype crystals to grow it into Jet Jaguar PP.
tooltip.reikogodzilla.jet_jaguar_pp.cont: R jet punch · V Archetype shield · G leap (Jet Jaguar PP with the Diagonalizer Code: release it)
message.reikogodzilla.shin_dormant: Shin Godzilla has spent all its energy. It stands frozen in place, cooling down... for now.
message.reikogodzilla.shin_evolving_3: The creature stops and steams. It is evolving.
message.reikogodzilla.shin_evolving_4: Shin Godzilla stops dead, shuddering. Its next form is coming.
message.reikogodzilla.shin_knocked_down: Shin Godzilla is down! Pump the coagulant!
message.reikogodzilla.shin_frozen: Operation Yashiori succeeds: Shin Godzilla freezes solid.
message.reikogodzilla.shin_plate_broken: A bunker buster tears into Shin Godzilla's back. Its blood pours out.
message.reikogodzilla.shin_tail_broken: Shin Godzilla's tail tip is destroyed.
message.reikogodzilla.shin_adapts: Shin Godzilla's body adapts to the attack.
message.reikogodzilla.godzilla_mutates: The creature absorbs the radiation... and becomes Godzilla.
message.reikogodzilla.heat_ray_backfire: The heat ray backfires inside Godzilla!
message.reikogodzilla.freon_needs_water: He has to be in deep water.
message.reikogodzilla.balloons_not_ready: Sink him with the Freon first.
message.reikogodzilla.wada_tsumi_sink: The Freon foams up around Godzilla and he plunges into the deep.
message.reikogodzilla.wada_tsumi_rise: The balloons inflate and start hauling Godzilla up from the depths!
message.reikogodzilla.wada_tsumi_free: Godzilla tears the balloons apart halfway up!
message.reikogodzilla.wada_tsumi_done: Godzilla is dragged to the surface, crushed by the change in pressure.
message.reikogodzilla.overload: The Shinden explodes against Godzilla's head!
message.reikogodzilla.overload_inward: The heat ray turns inward. Godzilla's head blows apart in light.
message.reikogodzilla.choose_to_live: You ejected. You chose to live.
message.reikogodzilla.king_ghidorah_born: Two more heads tear out of the storm: Ghidorah has become King Ghidorah.
message.reikogodzilla.storm_lure: The storm takes shape, and Ghidorah turns toward it.
message.reikogodzilla.storm_seeded: A storm gathers over the beacon.
message.reikogodzilla.probe_bounced: The probe bounces off the shield. Wait for it to drop, and aim for the fins.
message.reikogodzilla.filius_destroyed: The probes overload Filius from within. It explodes.
message.reikogodzilla.earth_overloaded: The probes overload Godzilla Earth's shield organ!
message.reikogodzilla.houtua_protects: The Houtua scale keeps the nanometal out.
message.reikogodzilla.assimilated: The nanometal takes the Vulture. It throws you out and joins the City.
message.reikogodzilla.city_hostile: Mechagodzilla City has fused with its pilots. It turns on everyone.
message.reikogodzilla.observer_broken: The Garbetrium totem shatters. Ghidorah is no longer observed for this world: now it can be hurt.
message.reikogodzilla.sp_amphibia: The creature drags itself onto land, growing legs.
message.reikogodzilla.sp_ultima: Under fire, Godzilla turns black and grows: Godzilla Ultima.
message.reikogodzilla.jet_jaguar_pp: Jet Jaguar PP stands up, giant.
message.reikogodzilla.too_big_to_pack: Too big to pack up now.
message.reikogodzilla.code_released: Jet Jaguar PP releases the code. The Catastrophe ends in crystal.
message.reikogodzilla.code_released_empt: Jet Jaguar PP releases the code. The Red Dust crystallizes.
message.reikogodzilla.titan_x_freed: The last implant breaks. Titan X is free.
message.reikogodzilla.titan_x_egg_taken: Titan X screams. Someone has taken her egg.
message.reikogodzilla.titan_x_calmed: Titan X takes her egg back and grows calm.
message.reikogodzilla.burning_millennium: Godzilla glows red: Burning Millennium Godzilla!
message.reikogodzilla.pump_no_target: No Shin Godzilla close enough: stand near its head.
message.reikogodzilla.pump_not_down: It has to be knocked down or dormant first.

event.reikogodzilla.gigan_invasion: Crimson streaks fall from orbit: Gigan Rex and his Gigan Miles.

event.reikogodzilla.frost_vark: The air turns bitterly cold. A Frost Vark is tunnelling toward you.
event.reikogodzilla.ion_dragon: A shrieking dragon trails sparks across the sky: the Ion Dragon.
event.reikogodzilla.kraken: Huge tentacles break the surface. The Kraken is hunting.
